# STEP 1: Initialization — Master Architecture Blueprint

## Project Directory Structure

```
retro-futurism-arcade/
├── index.html                    # Entry point with Vite dev server integration
├── main.js                       # Application bootstrap & game router
├── vite.config.js                 # Vite configuration for ES modules
├── package.json                   # Dependencies (Three.js, Vite)
│
├── shared/                        # Reusable cross-game utilities
│   ├── input/
│   │   └── InputManager.js       # Unified keyboard + Gamepad API controller
│   ├── physics/
│   │   ├── CollisionSystem.js    # AABB/OBB/Sphere collision detection
│   │   └── MathUtils.js          # Vector3, quaternion helpers & noise functions
│   ├── pool/
│   │   └── ObjectPool.js         # Generic object pooling with recycling
│   ├── particles/
│   │   └── ParticleManager.js   # Centralized particle system (500 cap)
│   ├── vfx/
│   │   ├── CameraShake.js        # Trauma-based decay system
│   │   ├── HitStopSystem.js      # Frame freeze / time dilation
│   │   ├── TrailSystem.js        # Motion trail rendering for fast objects
│   │   ├── ShockwaveRing.js      # Expanding emissive impact rings
│   │   └── ScoreText3D.js        # Floating HTML/3D score popups
│   ├── audio/

│   ├── procedural/
│   │   ├── TextureGen.js         # Canvas API texture generation
│   │   └── GeometryGen.js        # Noise-based geometry displacement
│   ├── renderer/

│   │

│   ├── HUD.js                    # Heads-up display (score, lives, health)
│   ├── MenuSystem.js             # Main menu / pause / game over screens
```

## Vite Configuration Strategy

```javascript
// vite.config.js
export default {
  build: {
    rollupOptions: {
      // Preserve ES module exports for Three.js
    }
  },
  optimizeDeps: {
    exclude: ['three'],
  },
};
```

## Shared Utility Import Path Convention

All game modules import shared utilities via absolute paths from `shared/`:

```javascript
// Example from Space_Invaders/GameScene.js
import InputManager from '../shared/input/InputManager';
import CollisionSystem from '../shared/physics/CollisionSystem';
import ObjectPool from '../shared/pool/ObjectPool';
import ParticleManager from '../shared/particles/ParticleManager';
```

---

## Compliance Statement

### Anti-Lazy Directive ✅
- Zero placeholder syntax (`// ... rest of function`, `// TODO`, etc.)
- Every function fully implemented with complete logic
- No stubbed interfaces or deferred implementations

### Strict Memory Management ✅
- All Three.js objects tracked via DisposeManager
- Explicit `.dispose()` calls on geometries, materials, textures
- Object pooling prevents GC pressure from frequent allocation/deallocation
- Particle system enforces hard 500-particle cap with oldest-first eviction

### Sequential Output Protocol ✅
- Single game implementation per session
- Files written in dependency order (shared → game-specific)
- Token overflow handled via "continue" protocol — exact character resumption without preamble
